        "Anisotropic Blobs"

        "Varied Blobs"

    (
        (np.random.rand(n_samples, 2), None),
        "No Structure"
    ),
]

# Set up clustering algorithms
default_bandwidth = 0.3
connectivity = None

clustering_algorithms = [
    ("MiniBatchKMeans", cluster.MiniBatchKMeans(n_clusters=3)),

    ("Birch", cluster.Birch(n_clusters=3)),
    ("GaussianMixture", mixture.GaussianMixture(n_components=3, covariance_type='full')),
]

if has_hdbscan:
    clustering_algorithms.append(("HDBSCAN", hdbscan.HDBSCAN(min_cluster_size=15)))

    connectivity = 0.5 * (connectivity + connectivity.T)

    for i_alg, (name, algorithm) in enumerate(clustering_algorithms):

        params = {}
        if name == "MeanShift":
            # Estimate bandwidth if not set
            from sklearn.cluster import estimate_bandwidth
            bandwidth = estimate_bandwidth(X, quantile=0.3)
            params['bandwidth'] = bandwidth if bandwidth > 0 else default_bandwidth
            algorithm.set_params(**params)
        if name == "AgglomerativeClustering":
            algorithm.set_params(connectivity=connectivity)
        if name == "SpectralClustering":
            algorithm.set_params(n_clusters=3, affinity='nearest_neighbors', random_state=random_state)

            algorithm.set_params(n_components=3, covariance_type='full', random_state=random_state)

            algorithm.set_params(n_clusters=3)

            algorithm.set_params(damping=0.9, preference=-200)

            algorithm.set_params(min_samples=10, xi=0.05, min_cluster_size=0.1)

            algorithm.set_params(eps=0.3)

            try:
                if name == "GaussianMixture":
                    algorithm.fit(X)
                    y_pred = algorithm.predict(X)
                else:
                    y_pred = algorithm.fit_predict(X)
            except Exception:
                y_pred = np.full(X.shape[0], -1)
        t1 = time.time()
        elapsed = t1 - t0

        plt.subplot(len(datasets), len(clustering_algorithms), i_dataset * len(clustering_algorithms) + i_alg + 1)
        colors = np.array(
            [plt.cm.nipy_spectral(float(i) / max(1, (y_pred.max() + 1))) for i in y_pred]
        )
        plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], s=10, color=colors, cmap='nipy_spectral')
        plt.xticks([])
        plt.yticks([])
        if i_dataset == 0:
            plt.title(name, size=10)
        if i_alg == 0:
            plt.ylabel(dataset_name, size=10)
        plt.text(.99, .01, f"{elapsed:.2f}s", transform=plt.gca().transAxes,
                 size=8, horizontalalignment='right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
